items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire
High School Graduate or High School GED
Driving Experience: Experience driving/maintaining large rigs (buses, fire engines, large Class A RVs)
EMR/Clinical Experience: Six (6) months of experience in an outpatient setting and experience with electronic medical records (Cerner preferred)

Clinical Responsibilities Performs patient/family registration and scheduling in the Electronic Health Record (EHR). Assists in prepping patients for examinations, performing vital signs, administering medications per physician order, and documenting all care in the patient’s medical record Acts with urgency to support physician productivity and follows all clinical protocols and OSHA standards. Maintains a clean, organized, and safe clinical environment at all times. Provides excellent customer service, including greeting families, using scripted communication, and assisting children with quiet activities as needed.

Mobile Clinic Operations & Logistics Vehicle Operation: Transports the Mobile Health Clinic safely to scheduled sites. Setup/Teardown: Sets up the clinic on-site, including exterior leveling/stabilization, activating onboard computerized systems, and preparing medical equipment (exam tables, scales, etc.). Maintenance: Completes daily pre-trip/post-trip vehicle inspections and monthly safety checklists (fire drills, emergency supplies, etc.). Coordinates maintenance and repairs on non-clinic days.

Unit Care: Performs "housekeeping" of the vehicle, including refueling, dumping waste, filling water tanks, and ensuring the unit is plugged into 50amp services upon return. Safety Coordination: Serves as the designated Partners for Healthy Students Safety Coordinator; reports all accidents, parking/driving violations, or damage to Engineering/Management immediately.

Patient Care & Ages Served Patient Care: Direct (Requires operating medical equipment and physical interaction with patients). Ages Served: Infancy through Later Life (Full spectrum, with a specific focus on pediatric school-aged populations).

Satisfactory completion of a formal Medical Assistant program pursuant to the Division of Allied Health Professions or military training that is equivalent to an accredited Medical Assistant program (determination by Dignity Health Medical Foundation H.R. department in conjunction with the State Division of Allied Health Professions.)
